names.note: The nominative the calendar's own name page gives, «Максим (Румянцев), мч.», with the rank word dropped; the day line gives the forename alone in the genitive and no surname. Read 13 October 2026.

death.note: The year the calendar's day line prints after his name: «Мч. Максима (1928).» It is the only date on the entry; no year of birth, no age and no day of death is given. Read 13 October 2026.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 июля ст. ст. — «Мч. Максима (1928).»
